This fish's life is sunshine, rainbows, and possibly even lollipops. It's easy-going, ready to make friends, and sure to see the best of every situation.
Some fish might wake up on the wrong side of the tank; this one LIVES there. This is a low-down troublemaker, so keep your distance... and don't try to hug it. It hates hugs.
No obstacle is too great for this fearless fish. It firmly believes it can tackle any challenge - all it needs is the chance.
No obstacle is too great for this fearless fish. It firmly believes it can tackle any challenge - all it needs is the chance.
You might not think much of this timid fish, but don't count them out. They're kind at heart, and hey - sometimes it's the shy ones that surprise us most.
This little one's a born genius, but it's no show-off; all they really want is the chance to move into a nice tank that's full of friends!
Incredible ideas float through this fish's mind like bubbles on a wave. Now if only they could focus, they'd be the most famous fish around!
A batty buddy for your tank, this straightjacketed swimmer can't be taken seriously. Let's at least hope it's happy. Maybe we'll find them a therapist fish one day!
Spunky and outgoing, this fish loves to make friends. It can be a little flaky, but it's a simple swimmer with a sweet smile who just wants to have fun.
Solid as a rock, this fish has been around the block a few times and has the scars to prove it. It may look scary, but don't worry - this is one fish who's got your back.
Fancy a swim to the North Pole? Maybe a hunt for Atlantis? Just your average day for this enterprising explorer. They'll always have amazing tales to tell their fishy friends!
What a stunning little beauty! This fabulous fish is sure to be the talk of the tank. With all that attention, they'll have no trouble making friends.
This fish plays by its own rules. It'll never let the man keep 'em down, and the only fins it'll trust are its own. A loner, sure, but isn't it just a bit cool, too?
Content to float through life without a care, this fish is more focused on the fantastic world inside its head. What visions do you suppose it sees when it closes its eyes?
This hilarious fish loves to laugh. It'll do what it can to put a smile on your face, and with its assortment of terrific tricks, that won't take very long!
Seems like this oversize swimmer is only happy when it's taking more than its fair share. A green-eyed monster with fins, they want it all - and they're not shy about it.
Laid-back and stylish, this fine fella's content to watch the world float past their slick shades. So relaxed!
They may not be the life of a party, but this clever critter's got one of the biggest brains in the tank! All it's missing is the courage to stand up and be noticed. I hope they find it!
Everyone wants to meet this fish! It's so sociable and always happy to hang out - but what do you suppose it does when it's not throwing parties?
Dark and sinister thoughts swirl through the mind of this frightful fish. What vile plans could it be hatching now? Better keep a close eye on this one.
Rumors are like delicious candy to this talkative fish. Don't tell it anything you'd want to stay secret, and make sure they have an unlimited phone plan!
This is no ordinary clownfish - it went to Clown Academy! Armed with a wacky sense of humor and a bag full of silly props, it's sure to brighten up any tank.
Let's see your good side! This fish is an impossible shutterbug, always snapping photos of the other fish. It'd probably have more friends if it weren't so pushy about it.
Rah, rah, fish are great! This fish is full of spunk and spirit - it's happy to cheer any occasion, and its boundless enthusiasm will bring new energy to the tank!
Hear that music? Then it's time to hit the dance floor with this lively lil' swimmer! This fish loves to shake its fins. When there's a good beat, it just can't help itself!
This paint-spattered creative has a vision it'll follow to the ends of the ocean. Nothing can stop them from putting brush to canvas and drawing their dreams.
As seen on TV! This master salesfish is a fast-talking genius who can sell almost anything to anyone. Don't stick around too long, or you'll end up buying half the tank!
Not every fish gets up in the morning and decides to run for Tank Leader - but our presidential pal here is no ordinary fish. A smooth talker, they can get anyone on his side.
The most suave spy your tank will ever see, this fish's mission is to maintain peace and order under the waves. Evil beware - Agent Fish is here!
This fish has a bad reputation, but you shouldn't judge of book by its- hey! HEY! Where's my wallet?! ROBBER FIIIIISH!
What has science done?! This freaky fish will be meddling with the laws of nature in no time. Let's hope its discoveries don't blast the tank to bits!
Down on your luck? Well, misery loves company, and the hobo fish will help share your sorrows. They'll even take care of any aluminum cans around your tank...
Oh my - we have a celebrity here! This fish has already starred in all sorts of famous movies and plans to go for more! This is how you add star power to your tank!
Rock on! This fish lives to blast its magnificent music from the center stage. It'll never go anywhere without its guitar and a school of groupies!
This fashion-obsessed fish is always at home on the runway! All they want to do is strut their stuff on the catwalk while wearing the best designs - and what's wrong with that?
Reach for the stars! When the tank manages to build its first rocket, this is the mighty fish who will ride it into the heavens. Houston, we are go for launch!
Arr! This fish is on an endless quest for stupendous treasure. It's following all the clues, and it'll do whatever it takes to get the gold...
Silent as shadow, deadly in darkness, swifter than the sea - watch out! This fighting fish has been trained in ancient arts and it's not afraid to use them.
Check the music charts and you'll find this fish floating at the top! It's got a true gift for song and can't wait to go global. Prepare yourself for some sweet sound!
Zounds! This spellslingin' swimmer has more mystic might in one little fin than most fish could hope to have in a lifetime! Let's just hope they'll use their powers for good...
Yeehaw! Ride those seahorses! This rough n' tumble fish will wrangle a tankful of fun. Just don't let them ride off into the sunset. Yahoo!
Have you seen the latest styles? Aren't they beautiful? Well, there's a good chance they were made by the nimble fins of this very fish. Its designs are the height of fishion!
Majestic beauties of the deep, unicorn seahorses are a magical and mysterious addition to any tank. They love to frolic in the sunlight, and rainbows follow in their wake.
Hopes, dreams, and happiness follow in this fabled fish's wake. Watch your tank fill with joy - and sparkles! - after a wave of its wand and a pinch of fairy dust!
AwooOOOooo! This fella loves flannel, full moons, and pretty - but clumsy - girls. Absolutely hates vampires for some reason, though. Especially if they're shirtless.
It vants your blood! Dark and mysterious, this fish loves candlelight, brooding, and love triangles. Can't stand werewolves, though. I wonder why...
An uplifting choir seems to follow this fish. Its halo shines with inner goodness, and its heart beats with truth and hope. This is a truly heavenly fish, and rarely seen.
This fearsome fellow will set your skin crawling! No need to rush for the proton packs, though - it's a friendly ghost, ready to give you a ghoulishly good time!
Something wicked this way comes. This devil ray casts a grim pall over the tank with its fiendish presence. Who are they, really? What do they want? No good will come of this.
This rare, radiant fish sparkles with an inner fire. Gentle and wise, this is a true ruler of the deep and certainly a girl's best friend!
This fish is a rare gem with a sparkling personality! It'll surely bring a sparkle to any tank, but watch out for thieves - they might just mistake it for jewelry!
Breathtaking - never has there been a more majestic fish! But how can our tanks contain such a creature of space and stars? Only our phishicists may know for sure...
Socialite of the seas, this fish loves making friends and keeping everyone happy. They may be a bit of a gossip, but they're a sweetie at heart and a true ally.
This steadfast fish believes everyone has the right to freedom. The only question in its briny brain is which of these it likes more: Truth, justice, or liberty for all?
A blue beauty for only the most transcendent tanks, this brilliant bulb will bring a seductive sway to your realm. Fine fish of all flavors are sure to appreciate its majestic movements!
What a magnificent mind! This coral may not be any smarter than the next batch, but don't you think it looks rather intelligent?
Shh, they're tired! This coral's closed after a hard day of catching plankton, but don't despair - it's still quite pretty. Let's let the poor little fellas sleep, shall we?
The sinuous shape of this curled coral will keep your fish fascinated for untold hours. Take it to your tank today!
This interesting item may LOOK like a plant, but it's actually a living critter that just likes to stay in one place! These ancient creatures will give your tank a prehistoric pop!
Fan the flames of fashion with this flattened fin of coral! An oceanic classic, it'll look simply smashing sitting on the seabed of your tank.
Your biggest fan happens to be one of many - this delicate frond is the home of thousands of tiny critters, and I bet they'd all love to live in your tank!
Sure, it says 'coral' on the label, but watch out! These are more like jellyfish colonies, and they'll give you a nasty sting if you're not careful! Sure do look pretty, though...
These corals spread out nice and flat, pushing colorful plateaus in all directions. They're beautiful, fragile, and fashionable - get yours today!

Sometimes, you want to decorate your tank with elegance AND efficiency. Of course you could buy mushrooms and coral separately - but why not get BOTH in one handy package? Act now! Supplies are limited!

Sure, coral of any sort will bring glory to your tank and gratitude from your fish, but there's just something so refined about this one in particular. Don't you want to see the effects of its style on your little swimmers?
These lovely pink pillars may look like rocks, but they're actually living creatures! A beautiful addition to any tank, coral is a sign of refinement and elegance in a watery world.
This delicate creature looks sort of like an animated plate of pasta, but it's no meal! This anemone can deliver a surprising sting to the unwary, so hungry hunters had best give it a wide berth.

It's like a little underwater town of living towers! This elegant assortment of immobile animals will provide your fishy friends with a helpful hiding spot - and doesn't it just look gorgeous, to boot?
So elegant! Don't get too close, though; this anemone might look soft and squishy, but it can deliver a sharp sting to the unwary.
Such a classic coral! This plume stretches up to the light, giving your tank a terrific tone and your fish a fun hiding spot!
Ouch! Best to look - and not touch - this stylishly-spined submariner. Pointy he may be, but isn't he perfectly pretty, too? Sharp and sublime, you'd better act fast to snag this deep sea deal.
This phenomenal fungi has the striped style struggle settled. In terms of undersea mushrooms, its take on the lined look is utterly unequaled. Let's see how it fares in your tank!
A rising star in the deep, this captivating coral blooms brilliantly, shining with a style that's all its own. Warm and inviting, your fish will be happy to see it, day or night.
Incredibly rare and fragile, this tree of coral is a wonder to behold. Just be very, verrrrry careful around it...
Not so pointy now! This de-spined delight is an ideal art object for your tank. Take it home today!
One of the fastest-growing plants in the world, this evergreen will spring right up to give your tank a unique sense of style.

What fantastic seagoing style would be complete without a draconic dressing? This aquatic accessory is sure to be the perfect complement to any tank. Your fish will love its wavy wonders - why not indulge?
Where do you think this weathered wood washed up? Twisted by time and tides, this gnarled stump has copious amounts of character. I'm sure your fish will love its many nooks and crannies, too!
Don't weed these plants! Fish love the relaxing sway of this seaweed - it makes them feel like they're on a little aquatic vacation every time they're near.
It's like a little lawn! The scruffly foliage of these plants will fill your tank with delight and tickle the bellies of nearby fishes!
Far out, man. These odd entities will bring an unreal sense of the fantastic to your tank - and they're also delicious with pasta.
Pristine and sweetly sea-swept, this grass will give your tank the tidal touch it's been missing! Work this whimsical weed into your saltwater stylings and achieve an appearance to astonish!
So cute and delicate! Landlocked lavender is a true floral delight, so I can only assume its seaborne sibling is equally enjoyable. Why not take some to your tank today and find out?
Mmm, what delicious-looking leafy greens! I'll bet you could whip up a rather delicious deep sea salad with this appetizing algae. I suppose it would look pretty nice in your tank, too.
Why, they're like underwater dandelions! These glorious balls of green will add a touch of whimsy to your tank, delighting even the most finicky fish.
Look at all that algae! These rocks have been here for a while. They could probably use a good cleaning, but I have to admit they look pretty good as they are. So natural!
This old volcanic rock slowly cooled to form these oddly unnatural shapes - but there's nothing mystic about plate tectonics! It's just good 'ol geology at work. They sure do look pretty, though...

Talk about the Age of Aquarius! These mystic crystals shimmer in the dark, and I don't know about you, but I think holistic hunks of multi-faceted fun are just what's needed to spruce up a simple seabed.
From the heart of the volcano to you! This chunk of pumice may be a bit rough around the edges, but that just makes it perfect for scratching a pesky itch!
It's more than just a rock! Fish can relax in this stone's shade, hide here when they're scared, and have races around it for fun. It's like a little underwater playground.
Seeing red isn't always a bad thing! This shaded stone is just like its gray cousin, but with a little visual flair to let you step your style up a notch!

Perfect for skipping from bank to bank, these stones once tumbled along a babbling brook. I'm not sure how they got this far from shore, but as soon as your fish see them, they'll be grateful they did.
Sure, tossing a few rocks together might not sound impressive, but wait until you see how these look in your tank! Fish of all descriptions will flock to see such splendid stones!
A dark and delightful hiding spot for all sorts of shy swimmers, this stone cave provides security and sanctuary in an uncertain sea.
A terrific tower of rocks, these slabs climb upward into an impressive monument to you, your fish, and your shared sense of style!
It's like the lava you know and love, but in a shocking albino hue. This white rock might be just what your tank needs to have a matching color scheme - so don't delay!
We all know seaweed comes with a sublime sway, but none can stand against the stupendous size of this superb specimen. Tall and tempting, it'll take your tank to another level.
That's kinda cool. I wonder what happened to the rest of the ship, though...
Yikes! Look at that gruesome glow! Fishie, why would you bring THIS back?! It's probably still radioactive!
Ooh, a dinglehopper! Finally, something your fish can use to comb their hair.
Hey, great! Just three more, and we're on our way to a sweet underwater ride. Talk about your sea cruises, eh?
Ooh, a pearl! Think of all the things we can do with this! Good fish!
Double the delight! Your fish obviously wasn't content with finding you just one pearl. You've got a real go-getter on your hands!
Nice - it's a whole cluster of pearls! That's one overachiever of a fish you have there. Make sure to reward them with extra food and attention!
Pure pearlfection! You clearly picked the right fish for this job; they've brought you back TEN pearls! Wow!
You don't get more classic than this superb shell; it's a charming sight for any fish on a fairy-tale adventure!
Moovelous! These shells may take their name from landlocked livestock, but they're far more appealing to undersea suitors - get some soon!
This comfy cushion  provides pleasing padding upon which passionate fish may frolic!
Real flowers wouldn't do so well down here, but this tulip shell is absolutely at home in this sentimental sweet spot!
What fun frilly fans! These pretty plants are sure to liven up your tank and set the mood for romance!
These sweet sponges are all set to dot the domain of your tank's most frolicsome fish!
This terrifically-tasseled accessory is sure to leave your lovebirds breathless - get it today!
Superb! The seductive sway of this kelp will lull your lovers into a state of benthic bliss!
Lillies and love go together so well - these pretty pads have a place near any passionate embrace, so why not add them to your tank, too?
These totally tubular sponges have a style that's all set to make a splash in your breeding tank - buy 'em now!
Much like love has many branches, this coral curls in countless directions. Isn't it just delightful? I'm sure your fish will think so!
Mmm, mm! Dark and delicious, this chocolate is the perfect snack for your breeding tank's cute couples.
Pop the cork! What kind of love nest leaves its lovers without a bit of bubbly?

Kind of old and smelly. I hope there's nothing hiding inside...
Ouch! Careful with this. Wouldn't want to snag a poor fish by accident.
Darn, empty. With today's prices, just think how many fish a full can of gas would get us!
How did these get down here? Someone is putting WAY off the green.
I really hope there aren't any accidents happening now that this sign is gone...

Anyone up for some underwater volleyball? It plays pretty much like normal, 'cept it's really hard to spike.
I bet someone's missing this! Well, at least we can build undersea sand castles now!
Fine, pristine porcelain. There's no storm in this teacup, but perhaps it was lost in one...
Ooh, these look delicious. Anyone have some butter and garlic around?
Not quite an acceptable form of currency, but it sure looks nice.
Your fish will always be the stars of your tank, but it couldn't hurt to have a backup or two...
I think your fish might have trouble playing this. For a number of reasons.
I think it's from an old Grecian temple. Seriously, how are your fish finding these things?!

This is absolutely gorgeous - it's a shame fish don't have necks!
I can show you the world! Shining, shimmering, splendid!

What a lovely pocketwatch! Say... I hope your fish didn't just steal a precious heirloom.
Good thing your fish can't swing this; otherwise it'd be a dangerous addition to the tank!
Very nice, but... but what happened to the diver?!
I really hope this is just a copy. Otherwise, your fish might be an extremely clever thief...
Bringing this thing underwater is just a bit silly, don't you think?

Make your tank an official sister city to a far-off land with this oriental arch.
Very nice - but I guarantee someone in the military is not pleased about it being here.
